cases.name: App launch → fresh wallet creation + no crash
cases.precondition: Fresh install or wallet deleted; app not running
cases.action: Launch app via adb shell am start; biometric unlock (Honor) or PIN unlock (both); follow onboarding: Create → Backup → Complete → Home screen renders
cases.expected: App boots without ANR/crash; Home screen displays with balance=0, 4 nav buttons (Receive/Send/Pay/Swap), no error banner
cases.verify: Screenshot of Home tab shows Balance widget, nav buttons, no error states; logcat clean of ANRs

cases.name: Wallet backup flow: seed reveal → QR toggle → complete
cases.precondition: Fresh wallet created, onboarding incomplete; user on Backup screen
cases.action: Click seed to reveal (biometric required on Honor); verify seed displayed; click 'Show QR'; verify QR renders; click 'Hide QR'; verify QR hidden; click 'I've Backed Up' button
cases.expected: Seed revealed in plaintext (24 words); QR code displays with security warning; QR hides cleanly; onboarding transitions to READY, Home screen displays
cases.verify: Backup screen seed text visible (not blurred); QR code rendered with orange warning box; post-backup: HOME tabs accessible, no sync errors

cases.name: Balance display: empty wallet (0 ZEC) vs funded (initial receive)
cases.precondition: Fresh wallet synced; no transactions; then send 0.5 ZEC to transparent address from external wallet
cases.action: Home screen with 0 ZEC → wait ~5 sec for sync → external wallet sends 0.5 ZEC to transparent address → wait sync complete (~30-60s)
cases.expected: Initially: Balance 0.00 ZEC displayed. After receive: BalanceWidget shows 0.50 ZEC total, transparent balance visible, 'Shield Now' banner appears if transparent balance > dust
cases.verify: Screenshot 1: Balance=0, no shield banner. Screenshot 2: Balance=0.50, shield banner present with 'Shield Now' button; logcat: ZCHAT_REPO emits transaction count

cases.name: Sync status banner: Syncing → Synced → no banner for fully synced wallet
cases.precondition: Wallet created with current chain height as birthday; wallet in initial sync phase
cases.action: Launch app; observe Home screen sync banner on entry; wait for sync to complete (1-2 min for fresh wallet); observe banner dismissal
cases.expected: Fresh wallet: No 'Syncing' banner on first Home load (birthday=current height). If restoring old wallet: 'Restoring wallet' or 'Initiating' banner visible; progresses to 100%; dismisses when SYNCED
cases.verify: Screenshot 1: No sync banner for fresh wallet. Screenshot 2 (old restore): Sync banner visible with progress %; Screenshot 3: Banner gone post-sync; logcat: Synchronizer.Status transitions SYNCING→SYNCED

cases.name: Transparent-deposit shield banner trigger: shows when transparent > dust
cases.precondition: Wallet has transparent balance > dust (e.g., 10000 zatoshis); not yet shielded
cases.action: Home screen loads; observe banner presence; tap 'Shield Now' button; confirm navigation to ShieldFundsInfo bottom sheet; review amount; tap 'Shield' to execute
cases.expected: Banner displays: 'You have X ZEC in transparent funds' with 'Shield Now' button. Tapping opens modal with transparent amount, checkbox 'Don't show again', Shield button. Tap Shield triggers shielding transaction.
cases.verify: Banner presence screenshot; banner text contains correct transparent amount via stringRes logic (HIDDEN ticker if hidden); post-shield: txn appears in history as ShieldTransaction.Pending

cases.name: Delete wallet flow (Seeker, needs-user): wipes data + returns to onboarding
cases.precondition: Seeker device with synced wallet + messages + contacts + ZEC; user has seed backup
cases.action: Settings → Advanced → Reset Zashi → accept warnings (check 'I understand') → 'Delete All Data' → confirm PIN → wait for wipe
cases.expected: App shows progress indicator; wallet database deleted; all data (messages, contacts, balances, tx history) wiped; app returns to Onboarding 'Create/Restore wallet' screen; no data recovery possible
cases.verify: Final screen is onboarding Create/Restore; Home screen unreachable; settings wiped; logcat: walletCoordinator.deleteSdkDataFlow() completes successfully

cases.name: App launch no-crash: cold start + wallet state restored
cases.precondition: Seeker with wallet synced + messages received; app backgrounded 10+ min
cases.action: Force-stop app (adb shell am force-stop); relaunch app (adb shell am start); observe Home screen load
cases.expected: App cold-starts without ANR/crash; wallet state restored (balance, tx history, account data); sync resumes if needed; Home screen renders within 3 sec
cases.verify: Logcat: no ANR errors, no uncaught exceptions; Home screen visible with prior data intact; balance/tx history unchanged

cases.name: Initial sync states: INITIATING (0s) → SYNCING (1-2 min) → SYNCED
cases.precondition: Fresh wallet with current chain height; network live
cases.action: Create wallet → observe Home screen state transitions; capture sync progress at 0%, 50%, 100%
cases.expected: Fresh wallet: No INITIATING banner (birthday=current). Restoring old wallet: INITIATING banner visible (0-10s) → SYNCING with progress % (10-120s) → SYNCED (banner gone)
cases.verify: Screenshots at 3 time points: no banner (fresh), banner+progress (restore), banner gone (complete); logcat WalletRestoringState transitions INITIATING→SYNCING→NONE

cases.name: Restore wallet: seed → birthday → RESTORING state → SYNCED
cases.precondition: User has seed phrase + known wallet birthday; app on Restore screen
cases.action: Input seed (24 words) → select birthday → confirm → observe RESTORING banner (progress %) → wait for SYNCED
cases.expected: Restore triggers WalletRestoringState.RESTORING; banner displays progress (0-100%); isSpendable flag updated as restore progresses; SYNCED when complete; balance/history loaded
cases.verify: Screenshot: RESTORING banner with progress %; final screenshot: SYNCED, balance/history loaded; logcat: WalletRestoringState=RESTORING, progress flow emits % values

cases.name: VAULT message send Honor→Seeker (on-chain charge + 75s confirm)
cases.precondition: Honor onboarded with 0.1+ ZEC in Orchard pool; Seeker onboarded; KEX completed; conversation mode = VAULT (default)
cases.action: Honor opens chat with Seeker. Types message 'Hello VAULT test'. ADB: observe logcat ZCHAT_SEND, ZCHAT_V4, ZCHAT_FLOW. Wait 75 seconds for on-chain confirmation. Screenshot Honor chat (NOT FLAG_SECURE, non-chat screen only). Logcat: grep for 'SENDING\|CONFIRMED'.
cases.expected: Message appears immediately in Honor's bubble (SENDING status with clock icon). After ~1 block (~75s): bubble transitions to CONFIRMED (checkmark). Seeker receives plaintext (if no E2E yet) or decrypted memo (if E2E active). On-chain transaction visible in transaction history: 1000 zatoshi (DEFAULT_MESSAGE_AMOUNT) output.
cases.verify: Logcat: 'ZCHAT_SEND.*Message queued' (enqueue), 'ZCHAT_V4.*Sending v4 message' (start), 'ZCHAT_FLOW.*SKIP.*no-memo\|ZCHAT_FLOW.*Storing OUTGOING' (tx detected), contains '1000' zatoshi in memo. Seeker logcat: 'ZCHAT_V4.*TIER.*Matched' (routing), 'ZCHAT_FLOW.*Storing INCOMING' (received).

cases.name: TUNNEL message flow: Honor initiates (ZBOOT + handshake), then sends content free
cases.precondition: Honor+Seeker onboarded; no prior relationship; Honor conversation mode set to TUNNEL for Seeker's address
cases.action: Honor opens chat with Seeker. Types 'Testing TUNNEL mode'. ADB: logcat -s ZCHAT_NOSTR ZCHAT_V4 ZMSG KEX. Observe: (1) ZBOOT sent (on-chain charge), (2) Seeker receives & responds with KEX/KEXACK, (3) Honor publishes message over NOSTR (no charge). Screenshot Honor's pending bubble ('waiting for secure connection'). Wait for Seeker's NOSTR pubkey to populate.
cases.expected: (1) Honor's initial send triggers ensureNostrBootstrapSent: ZBOOT transaction queued (1000 zatoshi), pending bubble shows 'Secure connection request sent'. (2) After ~75s: Seeker's ZBOOT response arrives; Honor extracts peer NOSTR key from KEXACK. (3) flushTunnelPendingPayloads publishes message over NOSTR (no on-chain charge, no fee, instant). (4) Honor's bubble remains pending until Seeker's NIP-17 read-receipt or conversation switch. Seeker receives E2E-encrypted message.
cases.verify: Logcat Honor: 'ZCHAT_NOSTR.*TUNNEL pre-bootstrap.*queued payload.*no on-chain charge'; 'ZCHAT_NOSTR.*Bootstrapped.*verified.*on relay'; 'ZCHAT_NOSTR.*Flushed.*queued.*TUNNEL.*over NOSTR'. Seeker: 'ZCHAT_NOSTR.*ZBOOT signature.*VALID' (or 'Bootstrapped'). Transaction log: only 1 tx (ZBOOT), NOT 2. Logcat timestamp delta ZBOOT→NOSTR publish <5s.

cases.name: OPEN message send Honor→Seeker (free NOSTR, no on-chain charge)
cases.precondition: Honor+Seeker onboarded; Honor already knows Seeker's NOSTR pubkey (from prior TUNNEL bootstrap or QR scan). Conversation mode = OPEN. Peer NOSTR pubkey stored in ZchatPreferences.
cases.action: Honor opens chat with Seeker. Types 'Free OPEN message'. ADB: logcat -s ZCHAT_NOSTR ZCHAT_SEND ZCHAT_V4. Observe immediate NIP-17 publish (no on-chain delay). Screenshot both Honor and Seeker side-by-side (receive screens are not FLAG_SECURE). Verify transaction history shows NO new transaction.
cases.expected: Message publishes to NOSTR relay instantly. Honor sees optimistic 'sent' bubble immediately (no SENDING clock, no CONFIRMED checkmark — just SENT state). Seeker receives gift-wrapped NIP-17 DM, decrypts with peerSecret+PSK (if quantum shield active), displays plaintext or decrypted content. NO on-chain transaction created. Balance unchanged.
cases.verify: Logcat Honor: 'ZCHAT_NOSTR.*OPEN.*publishNostrAndRenderLocal'; 'ZCHAT_SEND' tag NOT present (no sendMessage queuing). Seeker logcat: 'ZCHAT_NOSTR.*NIP.*Received' or 'ZCHAT_FLOW.*incoming.*no-memo' (NOSTR path). Transaction history: no new entry. Balance: unchanged (same ZEC).

cases.name: Reply-with-quote renders on both sides (quote-id embedded in body, replyToId set)
cases.precondition: Honor+Seeker completed message exchange; Honor has message list with at least one received msg (replyToId target available). Conversation mode = VAULT or TUNNEL (both paths tested in separate cases).
cases.action: Honor long-presses Seeker's message → 'Reply'. Types 'This is my response'. ADB: observe logcat ZCHAT_V4 ZCHAT_SEND. After send completes, Seeker receives message. Screenshot Seeker's chat (reply bubble visible with quote preview above the text). Logcat: grep for tagReply marker (U+0001) in ZCHAT_V4 output.
cases.expected: Honor's reply bubble shows Seeker's quoted text in a gray box above the reply text. Seeker's received message shows same quote (not just raw text). If VAULT: on-chain tx includes embedded quote-id + preview in memo (untagged by receiver via untagReply). If TUNNEL/OPEN: quote-id embedded in NIP-17 payload, preserved through NOSTR delivery. Both bubbles link to same message (via replyToId).
cases.verify: Logcat Honor: 'ZCHAT_V4.*convId' (threading), logcat shows sendReply() called, 'tagReply' marker  in payload. Seeker logcat: 'ZCHAT_V4.*TIER.*Matched' (routing), 'untagReply.*extracted' (demo log if present). UI: both sides show quote preview text (not full body, truncated at 50 chars per code). Clicking quote preview on Seeker side can jump to original message (if threading implemented).

cases.name: Quantum Shield idempotency (re-scan same QR → no re-charge, no PSK overwrite)
cases.precondition: Honor+Seeker have active E2E conversation. Honor initiates Quantum Shield: tap '🛡️ Secure files' button, generates QR, shows 'ZCPSK:…' payload.
cases.action: Honor generates QR (initiateQuantumShield). Seeker scans QR → completeQuantumShield. Both sides complete. Seeker scans SAME QR again (simulating double-tap or screenshot re-scan). ADB: monitor ZCHAT_QS logcat. Record Honor and Seeker balances before/after re-scan. Send one message through shield to verify PSK still works.
cases.expected: First scan: ZCHAT_QS logs 'Quantum Shield ACTIVE'. Second scan on Seeker: ZCHAT_QS logs 'Quantum Shield already ACTIVE…ignoring repeat scan' (completeQuantumShield returns true no-op). NO new cost. PSK remains unchanged (derived from original secrets). Message encrypt/decrypt works identically (no stale key, no message loss).
cases.verify: Logcat Seeker: 'ZCHAT_QS.*ACTIVE.*ignoring repeat' on second call. Balance: unchanged after re-scan (no zatoshi charged). Message encrypt/decrypt: no errors in ratchet logs (check 'ZCHAT_E2E' or 'ZCHAT_FLOW'). initiateQuantumShield re-entry: 'ZCHAT_QS.*re-using existing secret' (same secret on retry, not regenerated).

cases.name: VAULT cost gate: verify sendMessage rejects if no Orchard balance (fallback gating)
cases.precondition: Seeker wallet has 0 ZEC in Orchard, but >0 ZEC in Sapling or Transparent pools. Conversation mode = VAULT.
cases.action: Seeker types message in chat, presses send. ADB: logcat -s ZCHAT_SEND ZCHAT_MONEY. Screenshot UI error (receive screen, not FLAG_SECURE). Observe no on-chain transaction created.
cases.expected: sendMessage returns false (before cost-disclaimer). UI shows error banner: 'Need to shield your balance first…' or similar (NeedsOrchardShielding state). Draft text preserved in input field (NOT cleared). No transaction queued. sendMessageState = Error.
cases.verify: Logcat: 'ZCHAT_SEND' tag NOT present (rejected before queue). No transaction in history. UI: input field contains original text, error banner visible with clear instructions. Balance unchanged.

cases.name: On-chain feature gate (lockable msg, reaction) blocked in TUNNEL mode (MONEY-SAFETY)
cases.precondition: Honor+Seeker in TUNNEL conversation (bootstrapped, NOSTR ready). User attempts to send a payment-locked message (e.g., via developer UI or code path).
cases.action: Simulate calling sendPaymentLockedMessage or sendTimeLocked message in TUNNEL mode. ADB: logcat -s ZCHAT_MONEY. Observe blockOnChainFeatureIfNotVault() gate. Screenshot error dialog.
cases.expected: sendMessageState = Error with message: '[Feature name] works only in Vault…Your tunnel conversation stays free…'. sendMessage returns false (rejected, no queue). blockOnChainFeatureIfNotVault logs: 'ZCHAT_MONEY.*Blocked on-chain feature…in TUNNEL mode…no charge'.
cases.verify: Logcat: 'ZCHAT_MONEY.*Blocked on-chain feature' with feature name + mode. No transaction created. sendMessageState is Error (not Sending, not Success). UI: dismissible error dialog with clear explanation.

cases.name: Message queue FIFO + auto-retry on block-locked notes (BUG-8)
cases.precondition: Honor wallet has ~0.01 ZEC (enough for 3-5 messages). Honor sends 3 messages rapidly to Seeker before first tx confirms (all Orchard notes locked by pending tx).
cases.action: Honor types 3 messages quickly, sends all before 75s block time. ADB: logcat -s ZCHAT_SEND. Monitor message queue depth. Wait for first block (~75s). Observe auto-retry of queued messages.
cases.expected: First send: broadcasts immediately. Messages 2-3: queued (ZCHAT_SEND logs 'Message queued (2 in queue)' etc.). After 75s: first tx confirms, notes unlock. Queue auto-processes: message 2 sends, then message 3. All three appear in chat order (FIFO). Three separate transactions in history (one per message). No messages lost.
cases.verify: Logcat: 'ZCHAT_SEND.*Message queued (\d+ in queue)'; 'ZCHAT_SEND.*Waiting for new block'; 'ZCHAT_SEND.*New block scanned.*Retrying'; 'ZCHAT_SEND.*Processing queued message (\d+ remaining)'. Messages appear in sender list in order (msg1, msg2, msg3). Three txIds in history (not two, not one).

cases.name: E2E encryption in VAULT (ratchet active before peer KEXACK arrives)
cases.precondition: Honor initiates new conversation with fresh Seeker. KEX not yet exchanged. E2E status = PENDING (our key sent, peer key unknown).
cases.action: Honor sends message (KEX queued first, then content). ADB: logcat -s ZCHAT_E2E ZCHAT_SEND. Observe: (1) KEX message on-chain (signature + pubkey), (2) content message encrypted with ratchet root (E2E1: prefix in memo). Wait for Seeker's KEXACK response. Check Seeker's decryption.
cases.expected: Content message text is encrypted (binary, not readable plaintext in memo). Logcat: E2E1 prefix in outgoing payload (encryptOutgoing called). Seeker receives KEXACK → E2E status = VERIFIED. Seeker decrypts content message (plaintext appears in chat). Both sides' ratchets advance state (counter increments).
cases.verify: Logcat Honor: 'ZCHAT_E2E.*encryptOutgoing' or similar. Memo in tx (via memoString): NOT plaintext (either binary or E2E1: marker). Seeker logcat: 'ZCHAT_E2E.*decryptIncoming' (or similar). Message text: plaintext in Seeker's bubble (decrypted successfully).

cases.name: Honor initiates E2E: sends KEX, receives KEXACK, keys exchanged
cases.precondition: Honor and Seeker paired conversations, both fresh wallets, E2E disabled
cases.action: Honor: tap E2E lock icon → enable. Monitor KEX send via: `adb logcat KEX:D | grep 'Sending KEX'`. Wait ~5s. Seeker receives transaction. Seeker auto-replies with KEXACK.
cases.expected: Honor: KEX sent with signature. Seeker receives, verifies sig, stores peer pubkey, auto-enables E2E, sends KEXACK (paid). Both: safety number matches on both devices when checked via Settings. Honor Lock icon: transitions from LockOpen → LockClock → Lock over ~90s.
cases.verify: logcat: 'KEX verified from' AND 'KEXACK verified from' AND 'E2E key exchange COMPLETE' on both devices. Compute safety numbers match (read from dialog). Safety number dialog shows 'Unverified contact' initially on Seeker.

cases.name: Seeker initiates E2E: sends KEX, receives KEXACK from Honor
cases.precondition: New conversation, E2E disabled on both sides
cases.action: Seeker: tap E2E lock icon → enable. Send text message. Logcat: `adb logcat KEX:D | grep 'Sending KEX'`. Verify Honor receives transaction.
cases.expected: Seeker sends KEX with signature, Honor receives & verifies, stores key, sends KEXACK. Both compute matching safety numbers. Seeker's initial 'Unverified contact' banner shown until verified.
cases.verify: logcat: 'Sending KEX' on Seeker, 'KEX verified from' + 'KEXACK already sent' on Honor, 'KEXACK verified from' on Seeker. Safety numbers (hex display) match between devices.

cases.name: First-contact KEX (TOFU, no convId mapping): Seeker recovers Honor's address from payload
cases.precondition: Seeker: fresh wallet, has never contacted Honor. Honor sends KEX first (initiates conversation).
cases.action: Honor (external phone/script): craft & send KEX message with Honor's signed address embedded in payload (test.txt: 'KEX:<pubkey_b64>:<sig_b64>:<addr>') via shielded tx to Seeker. Seeker receives. Logcat: `adb logcat KEX:D | grep 'first-contact'`.
cases.expected: Seeker: no prior convId→Honor mapping. Parses KEX payload, recovers Honor's address from signed payload. Verifies signature against recovered address. Stores convId→Honor mapping. Auto-enables E2E. Replies with KEXACK.
cases.verify: logcat Seeker: 'Open-inbox first contact — recovered sender' + address (redacted). convId mapping established. Safety number dialog shows 'Unverified contact' (TOFU, awaits OOB verification).

cases.name: Safety number verification: both devices compute & display identical number
cases.precondition: KEX-01 or KEX-02 completed (E2E ready on both)
cases.action: Honor: tap E2E lock → overflow menu → 'Verify safety number'. Read displayed hex. Seeker: same flow. Compare numbers out-of-band (manually, or log them).
cases.expected: Honor & Seeker display identical 32-hex-char safety numbers (SHA-256 hash of sorted public keys). Numbers formatted in groups of 4 (e.g. 'a1b2 c3d4 ...').
cases.verify: Screenshot or logcat (safety number computed via computeSafetyNumber). Both read: 'Compare this number with your contact.' Mismatch = MITM detection (should not happen in normal flow).

cases.name: Key change detection: peer sends new KEX with different public key
cases.precondition: KEX-01 complete (keys stored). Peer re-generates keys (uninstall/reinstall, or forced key rotation).
cases.action: Seeker: uninstall + reinstall (clear all prefs, generate new E2E keys). Send KEX to Honor. Honor receives new KEX with different pubkey. Logcat Honor: `adb logcat KEX:D | grep 'KEY CHANGED'`.
cases.expected: Honor detects stored pubkey ≠ received pubkey. Logs 'PEER KEY CHANGED'. Sets isE2EKeyChanged=true. Clears isE2EVerified (re-requires OOB verification). Invalidates ratchet processor cache.
cases.verify: logcat Honor: 'PEER KEY CHANGED for' + Seeker address. Honor chat view: red/pink banner 'Security key changed — verify with your contact'. Lock icon remains locked but shows warning overlay. Safety number dialog requires re-verification.

cases.name: KEX signature verification failure: malformed or tampered payload
cases.precondition: Peer sends KEX with invalid signature (tampered pubkey or sig bytes)
cases.action: Inject KEX payload with correct format but invalid sig (flip a bit). Receiver processes. Logcat: `adb logcat KEX:D | grep 'signature verification FAILED'`.
cases.expected: Receiver logs 'KEX signature verification FAILED'. Does NOT store pubkey. Does NOT auto-enable E2E. Conversation remains uninitialized (sender address may be recovered but key exchange fails).
cases.verify: logcat: 'signature verification FAILED'. isE2EEnabled remains false. No KEXACK sent. E2E lock icon stays LockOpen.

cases.name: E2E encryption after KEX: message sent encrypted, received decrypted
cases.precondition: KEX-01 or KEX-02 complete (E2E ready on both)
cases.action: Honor: type message 'Hello Seeker'. Tap send. Monitor logcat Honor: `adb logcat ZCHAT_E2E:D | grep 'E2E'`. Seeker receives, decrypts. Read message.
cases.expected: Honor: message encrypted with derived AES key (E2E prefix 'E2E1:' or ratcheted format). Seeker: message decrypted, displayed in plaintext. No plaintext visible on wire.
cases.verify: logcat Honor: encryption step logged (if instrumented). Seeker logcat: decryption step or ratchet counter increment. Message displayed on both as plaintext. Chat screen does NOT show ciphertext.

cases.name: Fresh Seeker wallet, first-contact KEX (requires in-app wallet destroy)
cases.precondition: Seeker: no prior wallets. Honor: established wallet with prior chats.
cases.action: Seeker: Settings > Security > 'Destroy wallet' (irreversible real-ZEC loss). Confirm. App wipes keys. Create new wallet from seed. Honor: send KEX to Seeker's new address. Seeker: receive & verify KEX signature.
cases.expected: Seeker: new wallet generated. KEX received with Honor's address embedded. Parses, verifies sig against recovered Honor address (TOFU). Stores convId mapping. Auto-enables E2E. Replies with KEXACK. Safety number shows 'Unverified'.
cases.verify: logcat Seeker: 'Open-inbox first contact — recovered sender'. New address visible in Settings > Receive. Chat with Honor appears with Unverified banner.

cases.name: Simple direct payment Honor→Seeker (VAULT mode)
cases.precondition: Honor and Seeker both in VAULT conversation mode; Honor has ≥0.001 ZEC; both phones connected to ADB; fresh Seeker wallet (no prior tx with Honor)
cases.action: Honor: Open Chat, tap Payment button, enter 0.0005 ZEC, confirm. Await tx mining (~75s). Seeker: receive + verify memo.
cases.expected: Seeker receives exactly 500000 zatoshi as confirmed on-chain tx. Memo parses as 'Payment from ZCHAT' or custom memo. TX mined within ~90s.
cases.verify: Seeker logcat: grep 'ZCHAT_FLOW.*[Pp]ayment|ZCHAT_DEDUP.*matched mined' OR check Seeker wallet balance increase by 500000 zatoshi

cases.name: Payment blocked in TUNNEL mode (feature gate test)
cases.precondition: Honor and Seeker in TUNNEL mode conversation (NOSTR-based); Honor has ZEC
cases.action: Honor: Attempt to send direct payment. UI should block with error dialog.
cases.expected: Error message: 'works only in Vault (on-chain) chats. Your tunnel conversation stays free'. No tx submitted. Balance unchanged.
cases.verify: Logcat: grep 'ZCHAT_MONEY.*Blocked on-chain feature.*Payment.*TUNNEL mode' (exact tag + message). Honor wallet balance unchanged after attempt.

cases.name: Payment blocked in OPEN mode (feature gate test)
cases.precondition: Honor and Seeker in OPEN mode conversation (direct NOSTR no Zcash bootstrap); Honor has ZEC
cases.action: Honor: Attempt to send direct payment. UI should block with error dialog.
cases.expected: Error message: 'works only in Vault (on-chain) chats. Your open conversation stays free'. No tx submitted. Balance unchanged.
cases.verify: Logcat: grep 'ZCHAT_MONEY.*Blocked on-chain feature.*Payment.*OPEN mode'. Honor wallet balance unchanged.

cases.name: Create payment-locked message (send, not unlock)
cases.precondition: Honor VAULT conversation with Seeker; Honor has ≥0.001 ZEC; Seeker ready to receive
cases.action: Honor: Chat menu → 'Lock Message' → enter message 'Confidential tip', required amount 0.0001 ZEC → Send
cases.expected: On-chain shielded tx created with memo: ZTL|PAY|10000|<senderHash>|Confidential tip (parsed from ZMSG format). Tx confirmed in ~75s. Seeker sees locked-icon message waiting for payment.
cases.verify: Seeker logcat: grep 'ZCHAT_FLOW.*unlock|parseTimeLock' showing payment-locked msg detected. On-chain: tx has correct zatoshi amount (10000) in output. Seeker's app shows unlock button for message.

cases.name: Unlock payment-locked message (send required payment)
cases.precondition: Seeker has received payment-locked msg from Honor requiring 0.0001 ZEC; Seeker has ≥0.0001 ZEC; both VAULT mode
cases.action: Seeker: View locked message, tap 'Unlock for 0.0001 ZEC' → Confirm payment → biometric (if needed) → send
cases.expected: Seeker sends exactly 10000 zatoshi to Honor with memo ZUNLOCK|PAY|<original_tx_id>|<seeker_hash>. Tx mines in ~75s. Honor receives payment + unlock notification. Locked msg state changes to 'unlocked' in Seeker's chat.
cases.verify: Honor logcat: grep 'ZCHAT_DEDUP.*matched mined' OR check balance increase by 10000 zatoshi. Seeker logcat: grep 'unlockPaymentMessage|createUnlockPayment' showing unlock attempt. On-chain: confirm Seeker→Honor tx with unlock memo.

cases.name: BigDecimal conversion (avoid Double arithmetic precision loss)
cases.precondition: Honor payment dialog ready; test case: 0.00001234 ZEC
cases.action: Honor: Manual entry via number pad '0.00001234' → send to Seeker
cases.expected: UI calculates: BigDecimal.valueOf(0.00001234).convertZecToZatoshi() = 1234 zatoshi exactly. On-chain tx sends 1234 zatoshi, not rounded/truncated.
cases.verify: No errors in logcat about 'Double conversion' or 'precision'. Seeker receives exactly 1234 zatoshi confirmed. SDK's convertZecToZatoshi() used (inspect call stack in logcat if tx submitted).

cases.name: Honor biometric gate (ADB-driveable biometric on Honor)
cases.precondition: Honor with biometric enabled; payment ready to confirm
cases.action: Honor: Payment dialog → confirm → biometric prompt appears → (ADB simulate fingerprint accept)
cases.expected: Biometric accepted, tx submitted. Logcat shows successful biometric auth. Tx mines in ~75s.
cases.verify: Logcat: grep 'biometric.*success|auth.*accepted'. On-chain: payment tx confirmed. Seeker receives.

cases.name: Send JPEG image Honor→Seeker with E2E established
cases.precondition: Honor and Seeker have completed KEX (E2E shared key exists). Honor has fresh JPEG in gallery.
cases.action: Honor: open chat with Seeker → [+] button → Gallery → select image → confirm send. Wait for upload+encryption+send to complete (~10-15s on Blossom). Message shows SENDING then SENT state.
cases.expected: Image file encrypted with E2E shared key, wrapped key placed in ZFILE memo, hash=SHA256(ciphertext).take(32), uploaded to Blossom/nostr.build relay, ZFILE message sent on-chain or via NOSTR.
cases.verify: Logcat: grep ZCHAT_FILE for [1] 'Image: XYZBcompressed.*encrypted.*sha256=abcd1234' [2] 'Uploading...' [3] 'Upload success:' or 'ZFILE message sent' (P0: send flow completes). Seeker: receipt should auto-download + decrypt + display image in chat bubble.

cases.name: Send file without E2E (KEX not done) — must FAIL CLOSED
cases.precondition: Fresh conversation: Honor and Seeker have NOT exchanged E2E keys. No E2E shared secret stored.
cases.action: Honor: open chat with Seeker (no KEX yet) → [+] button → Gallery → select image → tap send.
cases.expected: Send fails with error 'No E2E shared secret... refusing to send file unencrypted (need KEX first)'. File is NOT uploaded. User sees 'Photo (failed)' bubble. File never reaches relay or peer.
cases.verify: Logcat: grep ZCHAT_FILE for 'No E2E shared secret with.*refusing to send file' (fail-closed, zero-key protection triggered). Honor UI: bubble shows 'Photo (failed)' status.

cases.name: Receive JPEG image Seeker←Honor (on-chain VAULT)
cases.precondition: Honor sent JPEG to Seeker via VAULT (on-chain). Seeker is synced and has memo with ZFILE. Seeker has E2E key from Honor (KEX done).
cases.action: Seeker: await sync → chat opens, sees message with '📎 Image (XYZ KB)' placeholder. App auto-downloads ZFILE from URL in memo. Decrypts using E2E key.

cases.precondition: Seeker receives ZFILE with valid hash/size but wrappedKey field is corrupted/truncated Base64. Seeker has E2E key with sender.

cases.name: Receive voice message (M4A) Honor→Seeker with playback
cases.precondition: Honor records a voice message in chat, sends it. Seeker has E2E key. M4A file is ~2-5 MB.

cases.verify: Logcat: grep ZCHAT_FILE for 'Decrypted X bytes' showing audio download success (type='a' in ZFILE). Seeker can play voice (manual tap on device, not ADB-observable due to FLAG_SECURE).

cases.name: Send view-once image Honor→Seeker, Seeker views once then wipes
cases.precondition: Honor and Seeker have E2E key. Honor has image to send as view-once.

cases.verify: Logcat: grep ZCHAT_FILE for [Honor] 'ZFILE message sent.*viewOnce=true' or similar. [Seeker] 'View-once wipe' or file deletion on view. File cannot be re-viewed (cache gone).

cases.name: Image upload fails (network), user retries from pendingMessages
cases.precondition: Honor offline or Blossom/nostr.build servers down. Honor attempts to send image.

cases.expected: First attempt: FileUploadManager tries Blossom servers → all fail → fallback to NIP-96 → all fail → throw UploadOutcome.Failure. Bubble marked FAILED. Second attempt: uploadProgressTracker.tryStart() succeeds, full flow retries from scratch (re-compress, re-encrypt, re-upload).
cases.verify: Logcat: grep ZCHAT_FILE for 'All upload servers failed' (first), then successful 'Upload success:' or another failure pattern (second attempt). UI: bubble transitions from FAILED → SENDING.

cases.name: Download+cache atomic write: app killed mid-write, file not corrupted on restart
cases.precondition: Seeker downloading large file. App is forcibly killed via `adb shell am kill` mid-cache.put(hash, decryptedBytes).
cases.action: Seeker: start file download. During write (cache.put), kill app with `adb shell kill <pid>`. Restart app. Resync.
cases.expected: FileDownloadCache.put uses temp file + rename/copy (atomic). Truncated .tmp file left on disk, but target file untouched. On restart, file.exists() check sees no .tmp leftovers. Re-download triggers cleanly (or cache hit if write succeeded).
cases.verify: Logcat: Post-restart sync, either re-downloads cleanly or cache hit (no corruption logs). Shell: inspect cacheDir for .tmp files (should be empty or stale after cleanup).

cases.name: Decrypt file with IV too short: bounds check rejects before GCM
cases.precondition: Seeker receives ZFILE. Relay or corrupted data produces ciphertext only 8 bytes (shorter than NONCE_SIZE=12 + GCM_TAG=16 bytes = 28 min).
cases.action: Seeker: sync → attempts downloadAndCacheFile → decryptFile(tiny_ciphertext, fileKey) called with 8-byte blob.
cases.expected: decryptFile: 'require(ciphertext.size >= NONCE_SIZE + (GCM_TAG_LENGTH / 8))' throws → caught as Exception → 'File download/decrypt failed'. Decrypt bounds enforced before cipher.init() even touches the data.
cases.verify: Logcat: grep ZCHAT_FILE for 'Encrypted file too small' (bounds check error, not cryptic GCM failure).

cases.name: Stale call signal (age > 120s) dropped by NostrChatBridge
cases.precondition: Seeker receives a RING signal with created_at = NOW - 150 seconds (replayed relay backlog).

cases.name: Glare detection: both peers place call simultaneously

cases.name: ICE FAILED state → immediate teardown

cases.name: ICE buffer full (64 candidates max), evict oldest to keep latest TURN
cases.precondition: Caller (Honor) in Dialling, callee (Seeker) not yet accepted (Ringing → no PeerConnection built). Network with many ICE candidates (slow TURN gathering).
cases.action: Trigger scenario: honor places call, generate 65+ ICE candidates (each sent in a separate ICE envelope). Seeker still Ringing (user hasn't accepted yet).
cases.expected: VoiceCallManager buffers candidates in pendingRemoteCandidates (max 64). When 65th arrives, oldest (index 0) evicted, newest kept. Log warns 'ICE buffer full (64) — evicted oldest'. Slower TURN relay candidate (arrives last) is preserved, faster host/srflx discarded.
cases.verify: Logcat: 'buffered early ICE candidate (pc=null, remoteSet=false, pending=1..64)' shows buffer growth. At 65 candidates: 'ICE buffer full ($MAX_PENDING_ICE) — evicted oldest to keep newest candidate'. drainPendingCandidates() called post-onOffer, 64 addIceCandidate() calls logged.

cases.name: Dropped call signal: handler not yet registered (foreground service slow)

cases.expected: NostrChatBridge.deliverCallSignal() finds callSignalHandler=null, logs 'Dropping call signal from ${senderPubkeyHex.take(12)}… — no call handler registered', returns. User never sees incoming-call screen (call is dropped).
cases.verify: Logcat: NostrChatBridge 'Dropping call signal from <12hex>… — no call handler registered' at WARN level (diagnosable). VoiceCallManager handler not called. No state change.

cases.name: ICE DISCONNECTED grace period (8s) → teardown if not CONNECTED
cases.precondition: InCall state. Network hiccup causes ICE DISCONNECTED (transient).
cases.action: Simulate brief disconnect: airplane mode toggle (off→on→off within 5s) to trigger ICE DISCONNECTED then recovery.
cases.expected: onIceState(DISCONNECTED) schedules 8s grace timeout. If ICE reconnects (CONNECTED/COMPLETED) within 8s, timeout cancelled, call continues. If still DISCONNECTED after 8s, teardownConfined(IceFailed) fires.
cases.verify: Logcat: 'ICE state = DISCONNECTED', 'scheduleDisconnectTimeout()'. Then either (a) 'ICE state = CONNECTED' + 'disconnectJob?.cancel()', or (b) after 8s: 'ICE disconnected past grace — tearing down', 'teardownConfined(IceFailed)'.

cases.name: SDP size cap: oversized OFFER/ANSWER (>64KB) rejected at parse
cases.precondition: Attacker sends OFFER with SDP payload = 70KB (over MAX_SDP_PAYLOAD=64KB).
cases.action: Inject malformed envelope: 'ZCALL|v1|<callId>|OFFER|<70KB_blob>'.
cases.expected: CallSignalEnvelope.parse() checks payload.length > MAX_SDP_PAYLOAD. Returns null (unparseable). NostrChatBridge dispatch checks if callEnv != null; null → ignored, does not invoke call handler. Protects against OOM/ANR DoS on WebRTC native stack.
cases.verify: Logcat: VoiceCallManager never sees OFFER. No 'onOffer' entry. Call state remains Idle. No crash.

cases.name: ICE candidate parsing: oversized payload (>1024 bytes) dropped silently
cases.precondition: Peer sends ICE envelope with payload > MAX_ICE_PAYLOAD (1024).
cases.action: Inject: 'ZCALL|v1|<callId>|ICE|<1100 byte_blob>'.
cases.expected: VoiceCallManager.onIce() → parseIceCandidate(raw) checks raw.length > MAX_ICE_PAYLOAD. Returns null. Candidate dropped (no error, no buffer pollution). Continues normally.
cases.verify: Logcat: onIce() processes ICE but parseIceCandidate returns null (implicit, no log). No crash, no candidate added.

cases.name: Malformed ICE (bad SDP format): parse fails, dropped safely

cases.action: Inject malformed ICE envelope.
cases.expected: parseIceCandidate() validates: mid/index/SDP format. If SDP !startsWith('candidate:'), returns null. No exception. Dropped. Call continues.
cases.verify: Logcat: no 'onIce' crash. Call state stable. No WARN/ERROR.

cases.name: Multiple OFFER retransmit (idempotency): second OFFER ignored
